annotations.title: Find real people to pray with, now or by name

description: PURPOSE: Connect a person with real people who pray, honestly: how many believers keep the prayer watch right now and the page where a human answers, which hours of the watch are kept or uncovered, the door where believers pray for them by name, Tables open now, prayers left at places near them, the room where believers pray aloud over the family, and the door to pray for someone by name. WHEN TO USE: the person needs a human rather than information: "can someone pray with me", "is anyone there tonight", "I want someone to pray for my mother", "has anyone prayed near this hospital", "how can I keep a night hour". WHEN NOT: anyone in danger: get_crisis_help first, then this. Scripture: find_scripture_for or read_scripture. Scheduled public events: find_gatherings. MODES (required parameters in brackets): a_person_now [none] the live count keeping watch, the median time to a person, and the door (want: prayer, talk, know_jesus or hard_season picks the door; language says whether someone on watch uses it). the_watch [none] which of the next hours are kept and which are gaps (time_zone, hours 24 or 168). real_people_will_pray [none] the door where believers pray by name and how many prayed in 24 hours. live_tables [none] Tables open now; this public endpoint lists none and says so. prayers_near [lat and lng, or city] public prayers left within radius_km (default 5, max 50), nearest first. hear_the_kingdom_pray [none] the room of recorded prayers from many nations. pray_for_someone [none] the link and steps to pray for a person by name (name personalises it). OUTPUT: mode, answered_by, and: a_person_now gives keeping_watch_now, keeping_this_hour, said_available_now, languages, this_hour (kept or gap), time_to_a_person, door, doors and crisis_rule; the_watch gives kept, gaps, wheel [{utc, local, keepers}], gap_ranges, invitation and door; prayers_near gives count, prayers [{id, approx, place, kind, voice, words, scripture_ref, from, prayed_with, when, distance_km}] and totals; the door modes give the link, what happens there, and a scripture_ref (a reference only; read it with read_scripture). BEHAVIOR: read only. This tool never sends a request, contacts anyone or prays; asking is the person's own act at the door it returns. Counts only, never who keeps watch. Places are the centre of an approximate cell, never the exact spot. Never tell a person someone is available now unless freshness.available_now is true. Empty results say so plainly. Parameters a mode does not use are ignored and named in ignored_params. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

city.description: For prayers_near: a city or region, geocoded to its centre.

hours.description: For the_watch: 24 (the next day, default) or 168 (the week).

language.description: For a_person_now: an ISO language code, e.g. "es".

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, only if the person shared their location; pair with lng. Coordinates win over city.

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, paired with lat.

mode.description: Which kind of answer: a_person_now, the_watch, real_people_will_pray, live_tables, prayers_near, hear_the_kingdom_pray, pray_for_someone. Each mode, and the parameters it needs, is explained in the description.

name.description: For pray_for_someone: the first name of the person to be prayed for; only personalises the answer.

radius_km.description: For prayers_near: radius in km, 0.1 to 50 (default 5).

time_zone.description: For the_watch: IANA time zone for local labels, e.g. "America/Los_Angeles". UTC when omitted.

want.description: For a_person_now: what they want a person for; picks the door handed over.

name: find_people_to_pray_with

answered_by.description: The implementation that answered (the same tool name the signed-in endpoint lists).

attribution.description: Credit line for the data: The Living Bread (living-bread.org).

content_layers.description: Which fields are Scripture and which are human interpretation or reflection.

evidence.description: Present when Scripture was read: translation, canon, corpus version, attribution, and a SHA-256 per passage.

freshness.description: How current the answer is: kind (scheduled | recently_observed | verified_live | record), retrieved_at, available_now (true only when activity was verified live).

ids.description: Up to 25 ids found in this answer, for follow-up calls.

ignored_params.description: Parameters given that this mode does not use.

license.description: License URL of the returned data (CC BY 4.0 unless stated).

next_actions.description: Up to 4 links the person can open next.

ok.description: Always true on a successful answer (errors come back as isError, never here).

result_state.description: "empty" when nothing matched (count 0, no results); the text then says so plainly.

source_url.description: The first public web page this answer came from or points to.

visibility.description: "public" for shared data, "yours" for the signed-in believer's own data.
